name: Bountiful Acres
tagline: Bountiful Acres 🌳 🌼 Nursery, Garden, Gifts, Landscaping Services
description: In Woodland, WA, Bountiful Acres raises Blueberries and Lavender on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
